They soon learn this man is not just a figment of their imagination, and if they flal asleep, there's a very good chance they may never wake up. Robert Englund plays the iconic Freddy Krueger in Wes Craven's horror classic. Heather Langenkamp stars as Nancy, one of cinema's most quintessential final girls. The film also features Johnny Depp's big screen debut as her boyfriend Glen.

description_paragraphs:
The 4pm shows are dubbed in English.
The 7pm shows are in the original Japanese with English subtitles. Hayao Miyazaki's celebrated family favorite reminds us to appreciate nature and our bond with the world around us.

After moving with their father to be closer to their hospitalized mother, Satsuki and Mei soon discover the friendly spirits of the nearby forest, who help the girls deal with their feelings in a difficult time.
Co-starring Catbus.

description_paragraphs: Music maestro David Byrne took inspiration from tabloid headlines to create the only film he's directed, an ode to the extraordinariness of ordinary American life. Byrne is also our on screen host, a visitor to the town of Virgil, Texas, who introduces us to the locals as they prepare for the town's 150th anniversary and the Celebration of Specialness. We meet a local singer who just wants to find his true love, a woman who can't seem to ever get out of bed, and a community leader who really enjoys veggies. Using Talking Heads music to stich together the town's happenings, Byrne creates a loving tapestry of stories, showing his audience that everyday life always has interesting tales beneath the simple surface.
